title: v1.1 release prep: CHANGELOG heading, docs sweep, tag message and release checklist
lead: Prepare ork v1.1.0 for the owner to tag: a `## v1.1.0 (date)` section in `CHANGELOG.md`, a sweep of the docs for statements the v1.1 slices made stale, the text of the annotated tag's release summary, and the release checklist from `AGENTS.md`. The owner writes the date, creates the annotated tag and pushes it; ork does not tag. This is the last slice of v1.1 and depends on every other v1.1 slice having landed.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`docs/release.md` (*proposed*; moved from the AGENTS.md section Release in commit aaf79eb, same text): the owner writes a `## vX.Y.Z (YYYY-MM-DD)` section in `CHANGELOG.md`, creates an annotated `vX.Y.Z` tag whose message is the short release summary, pushes the tag, and checks the Release Actions run. `docs/boundaries.md` (Hard rules): "ork does not tag." The workflow `.github/workflows/release.yml` runs on a pushed `v*` tag and on `workflow_dispatch`: it tests on Ubuntu and macOS, builds darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64 and linux/amd64 archives, and publishes them with `SHA256SUMS`. For a new release the notes are the annotated tag's message followed by the CHANGELOG section whose heading starts with the tag; an existing release keeps its notes and receives replacement assets with `--clobber` (`release.yml`, the `Publish release` step: the notes are read with `awk` on the second word of the `## ` heading, so the heading must read `## v1.1.0 (YYYY-MM-DD)`).

Precedent: v1.0.0 was prepared by commit `e396585` ("Release v1.0.0: CHANGELOG heading"), which inserted `## v1.0.0 (2026-10-31)` under the empty `## Unreleased` heading; its tag message is the single line `ork v1.0.0` (`git tag -l -n5 v1.0.0`). v1.0.0's GitHub release was made by hand (S212, Why); the workflow has not yet released anything. It is still labelled `Release (proposed)` and the dry run it asks for after landing is an owner action I could not check from here (MANIFEST-E.md, RP-Q3).

v1.1 scope as of 2026-10-31 (`slicer list --pass v1.1` and the owner's moves of S61, S62, S66, S179, S206, S123 and S192 to v1.2): the rows and new slices of the v1.1 plan. This slice does not decide what is in v1.1; it records what landed.

The docs sweep exists because these slices change user-visible behavior and many docs state versions or status. Known stale text today (2026-10-31): `docs/orchestrator-parity.md:141`, `:148` and `:167-168` say the spec drafting round (S179) is deferred to v1.1; the owner moved it to v1.2 on 2026-10-31. `PROJECT.md:103` and `docs/dashboard.md:4` speak of v1.0 and "v1.1 by default".

Slicer check: `slicer find "release prep"` lists only unrelated rows; nothing in slicer's roadmap covers ork's release.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
N-class when it lands (docs, one test, CHANGELOG): no internal/engine, internal/daemon or cmd path. It is last in v1.1, so it runs alone.

- `CHANGELOG.md` (the ## v1.1.0 (date) heading under an empty ## Unreleased, per the v1.0.0 precedent).
- `internal/release/changelog_test.go` (new; stdlib only, in the package that already holds `workflow_test.go`).
- `README.md` (the Install section, :22-40, and the status paragraph, only if they contradict the release), `PROJECT.md` (status lines near :65 and :103, only if stale), `docs/orchestrator-parity.md` (:135-148, :167-168: rows that moved), `docs/dashboard.md:4` and `docs/guide.md` (version statements only), and any other doc the sweep finds with rg -n "v1\.1|v1\.2" README.md PROJECT.md AGENTS.md docs/*.md (this includes `docs/release.md`).
- `docs/release.md:5-24` (the release workflow, moved from AGENTS.md in aaf79eb; `AGENTS.md:120-123` now only points to it): update only if the owner's dry run changed the procedure; the proposed marker stays until an adj record decides it.
- No change to `.github/workflows/release.yml` unless the dry run finds a defect; a defect there is its own slice.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
`internal/release/changelog_test.go`:
- `TestChangelogHasTheV110Section`: `CHANGELOG.md` has a heading matching `^## v1\.1\.0 \(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\)$` and it sits directly under `## Unreleased`. Fails first: there is no such heading.
- `TestChangelogUnreleasedIsEmptyAfterTheRelease`: the lines between `## Unreleased` and the first `## v` heading are blank. Fails first: `## Unreleased` holds the S108 and S212 entries today.
- `TestChangelogHeadingsMatchWhatTheWorkflowReads`: every `## ` heading is `Unreleased` or `vN.N.N (YYYY-MM-DD)` with a space-separated second word equal to the tag, and no two headings repeat a tag. This guards the `awk` step; it passes before the change.
- `TestChangelogMentionsEveryLandedV11Item` is not a Go test: it is the Check command below, because it needs `slicer`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first. Do not touch: any `.go` file outside the new test, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, the version string (`cmd/ork/main.go`: it is set at build time), or any tag. Do not create, move or push a tag, and do not run the workflow.

1. Preflight: every other v1.1 row is done (`slicer list --pass v1.1`, no open row; `slicer check`). Ask the owner for the release date and for RP-Q1 (the version, `v1.1.0`) and RP-Q2 (how long the tag summary is) in MANIFEST-E.md. If any open v1.1 row remains, stop and report; do not release around it.
2. CHANGELOG: insert `## v1.1.0 (DATE)` under `## Unreleased` and leave `## Unreleased` empty, exactly as `e396585` did. Do not reword the entries. If an entry says "*proposed*" it stays: only an adj record removes the marker.
3. Entries check: for each done v1.1 item (`slicer list --all --pass v1.1 --status done`) that changed behavior, make sure its id is in the v1.1.0 section; add the missing entry in the same style (one paragraph, `Docs updated:` line). Items that changed nothing a user sees (re-anchors, internal tests) need no entry. List what you added in the commit message.
4. Docs sweep: run `rg -n "v1\.1|v1\.2|Unreleased|proposed" README.md PROJECT.md docs/*.md` and fix only statements that are now false: a row described as v1.1 that moved to v1.2, a feature described as "future" that landed, a version number. Do not remove a *proposed* marker. Do not touch `docs/review-*.md` (dated reviews).
5. Release summary: write the annotated tag's message in the commit message body and in the handoff, in the length the owner picked in RP-Q2, plain sentences, no emoji, ASCII, no attribution line. The owner pastes it into `git tag -a v1.1.0`. The workflow appends the CHANGELOG section to it.
6. Release checklist (print it in the handoff; `docs/release.md` has the text): (a) merge this slice; (b) the owner runs `workflow_dispatch` from the Actions tab if the dry run has not been done since the last workflow change, and confirms Ubuntu and macOS tests pass, three archives and `SHA256SUMS` exist as artifacts, no release was created or changed, and the binaries print `dev-` plus the short SHA with `--version`; (c) `git tag -a v1.1.0` with the summary; (d) `git push origin v1.1.0`; (e) the owner checks the Release Actions run and the release page: archives, `SHA256SUMS`, and notes made of the tag message then the CHANGELOG section.
7. CHANGELOG: this slice's own entry is the heading itself; add no extra bullet.

Not a UI slice: no `internal/tui`, no golden view, no CLI output.

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): What release date goes in the `## v1.1.0 (DATE)` heading? -> landing date: the implementer uses the day the slice lands, and the owner edits it if tagging happens on a later day. How should the orchestrator-only Check lines in this slice be fixed? -> runnable: drop the `rg -n "^## "` line, because the three `TestChangelog*` heading tests already assert that order. Rewrite the done-items loop without `--all`, and without `python3` if the sandbox lacks it. The loop becomes `slicer list --status done --pass v1.1 --json --lean`, with each id checked by `rg -q` in `CHANGELOG.md`. Done when it prints only ids that changed nothing a user sees..

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/release`.
- `slicer list --pass v1.1` shows no open row before the slice starts.
- `for id in $(slicer list --all --pass v1.1 --status done --json --lean | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(*[i["id"] for i in json.load(sys.stdin)])'); do rg -q "\b$id\b" CHANGELOG.md || echo "no entry: $id"; done` prints only ids that changed nothing a user sees (explain each in the commit message).
- `rg -n "^## " CHANGELOG.md` shows `## Unreleased` then `## v1.1.0 (DATE)` then `## v1.0.0 (2026-10-31)`.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] The owner reads the CHANGELOG v1.1.0 section and the tag summary, runs the workflow dry run if needed, creates and pushes the annotated tag, and checks the release page. ork does none of these.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "Release v1.1.0: CHANGELOG heading, docs sweep and tag summary".
